notes.title: Controller Support Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41783802/d8be6766a3284b4ecedd98bfb9d431f37afaec40.png

Hello there! It's the first time I make a news post here on Steam.
I've been setting up the controller support and playtesting a lot to see if everything was working fine.

I'm not used to playing with a controller myself, but I hope you guys find it confortable, I didn't update text tutorial with the controller keys, I'll do that later.

I also added some small visual changes to the game, and a new door transition effect to help with understanding the change of layers.

Also! If you would like to follow the progress more closely, talk with me and/or suggest stuff. You can join the game discord! or Twitter!
I also do monthly Devlogs with all the progress and thoughs I do on the game! They go public after a month, so you can read them all if you want!

Hope to see you around!
